question: The word “persist” means:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. To continue to exist.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"persist"** means:

 
 
• To continue to exist or occur, especially for a longer time than usual. (जारी रहना, विशेष रूप से सामान्य से अधिक समय तक)
 
 
 
• **Example:** Despite the challenges, they persisted in their efforts to complete the project.
 
• **"Correct answer"** means:
 
 
• Referring to the specific answer that properly defines or fits the context of the question. (सही उत्तर)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The correct answer to the quiz question assured her a perfect score.

Therefore, the word “persist” means: **To continue to exist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To disappear quickly** (जल्दी गायब होना): To vanish or cease to exist in a short time.

 
 
• **Example:** The fog disappeared quickly as the sun rose.
 
 
 
• **To improve easily** (आसानी से सुधारना): To make or become better without much effort.
 
 
• **Example:** He improved easily with consistent practice.
 
 
 
• **To become perfect** (संपूर्ण बनना): To reach a state of flawlessness.
 
 
• **Example:** Her skills became perfect after years of dedication.
